sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Core Ethics

  • Ahimsa (Non-violence)
  • Satya (Truth)
  • Asteya (Non-stealing)

Metaphysics

  • Anekantavada (Many-sidedness)
  • Syadvada (Theory of 'Maybe')
  • Triratna (Three Jewels):
    • Samyak Darshana (Right Faith)
    • Samyak Jnana (Right Knowledge)
    • Samyak Charitra (Right Conduct)
  • Theory of Soul (Jiva): Existence of soul in even inanimate objects.
PrincipleSignificance
AnekantavadaReality is complex and multifaceted.
SyadvadaEpistemological stance of conditional predication.
